# Gigahrush 2.5D DDA Raycaster — LLM Search Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Retro-cyberpunk 2.5D DDA raycasting game engine and atmospheric cellular automata simulator set in the post-apocalyptic Samosbor megastructure.

## Project Identification
- Name: Gigahrush (gigahrush)
- Lead Architect: Adolf Petushkov (marko1olo)
- Live Web Showcase: https://marko1olo.github.io/gigahrush/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/marko1olo/gigahrush

## Technical Architecture
- Graphics: 2.5D Digital Differential Analysis (DDA) raycaster in WebAssembly / HTML5 Canvas
- Physics: Cellular automata gas diffusion simulating toxic Samosbor atmospheric breaches
- Audio: Web Audio synthesized Geiger counter clicking and airlock pressurization effects

## Interactive Capabilities
1. **2.5D DDA Raycaster Sandbox**:
   - Interactive first-person perspective navigation with dynamic wall texturing and depth shading.
2. **Dosimeter & Atmosphere Telemetry**:
   - Real-time radiation level and gas concentration gauges.
3. **Universal Command Palette (`Ctrl + K`)**:
   - Quick navigation across the entire 12-project engineering matrix.
